title: Building capacity and utilization
source: NYC School Construction Authority and NYC Public Schools, Enrollment, Capacity & Utilization Report (Blue Book) 2025-26, Target Calculation, via NYC Open Data

utilization.label: School utilization
utilization.definition: Calculated by dividing org. enrollment by org. capacity (target calculation). 1.00 = exactly full.
utilization.source_field: Org Target Util (gkd7-3vk7, Data As Of 09/09/2026); recomputed from summed Org Enroll / Org Target Cap for schools in more than one building

capacity.label: Target capacity
capacity.definition: Derived by multiplying each room used by the organization by the number of students it accommodates (target calculation), summed across the school's buildings.
capacity.source_field: Org Target Cap (gkd7-3vk7, Data As Of 09/09/2026)

enrollment.label: Enrollment (Blue Book)
enrollment.definition: Audited register as of Oct. 31, 2025 for the organization, summed across its buildings.

building_id.label: Building ID
building_id.definition: A discrete four-character code for each building (the building holding most of the school's students).

building_name.label: Building
building_name.definition: The present name of the building.

building_utilization.label: Building utilization
building_utilization.definition: Building enrollment divided by building capacity, all schools in the building combined (target calculation).

building_enrollment.label: Building enrollment
building_enrollment.definition: Enrollment for the building, the sum of the enrollment of the organizations housed in it.

building_capacity.label: Building capacity
building_capacity.definition: Each room in the building multiplied by the number of students it accommodates (target calculation).

n_buildings.label: Buildings
n_buildings.definition: Number of buildings in which the Blue Book lists this school.
n_buildings.source_field: count of rows per Org ID (gkd7-3vk7)

notes: Target calculation, the version the SCA publishes as the 'Classic Edition' and the only one on NYC Open Data. The report itself says Target Capacity and Utilization 'reflect aspirational goals for school buildings': maximum class sizes of 18 in pre-K, 20 in K-3, 23 in grades 4-8 and 25 in grades 9-12 (previously 28 and 30 for grades 4-8 and 9-12).

Enrollment is the audited register as of Oct. 31, 2025. Capacity comes from the Principal Annual Space Survey, in which principals report how each room is used; SCA verifies a share of buildings each year.
Utilization = enrollment / capacity. Over 1.00 means more students than the target seats. The SCA notes one statistic cannot capture the full picture of how a building's space is used.

A school spread across several buildings (common for District 75 and some high schools) has its enrollment and capacity summed across buildings and utilization recomputed from those sums, matching the SCA's own rounding rule. building_* fields describe the building holding most of the school's students; n_buildings says how many there are.

District 75 inclusion programs (Incl. Class '#') carry enrollment but zero capacity in host buildings, because those students sit in general-education classrooms counted in the host school's capacity. Summing them, as the SCA does in its TOTAL lines, nudges a District 75 school's overall utilization up.
Blank cells (no enrollment or no capacity reported for an org in a building) are null. Programs with no capacity (e.g. some YABC and adult programs) have null utilization.

Org-to-DBN crosswalk: 1700 via the DOE LCGMS list (Location Code), 6 via NYC Open Data 2019-20 School Locations, 8 via a unique atlas DBN ending in the Org ID (District 79 programs), 1 manual (Renaissance Charter School, matched on building Q885).

SCA orgs with no DBN match (21), mostly alternate learning centers and adult or citywide programs: K755 ADULT AND CONTINUING EDUCATION (enrollment 0); K891 BROOKLYN NAVY YARD STEM CENTER (enrollment 0); K983 ALC - MS 258 (enrollment 0); K984 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - K (enrollment 0); K987 ALC - JOHN JAY (enrollment 0); K991 ALC- PROSPECT PLACE (enrollment 0); M951 MID-MAN ADULT LEARNING CENTER - M (enrollment 0); M984 LYFE PROGRAM (enrollment 0); Q975 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - Q (enrollment 0); Q987 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - Q (enrollment 0); Q988 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - Q (enrollment 0); Q995 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - Q (enrollment 0); Q996 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - Q (enrollment 0); Q998 NYC SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION AUTHORITY - Q (enrollment 0); R971 ALTERNATE LEARNING CENTER - S.I.
